top_creatures.label: Caster-bound pack runner
top_creatures.why: A companion owned by its caster and removed by a call, so the summon is a tool. Silhouette and sound not read (art is in the game archives); listed for the behaviour only.
top_creatures.keep: caster-owned associate slot; remove call on expiry or dismissal
top_creatures.change: our beast is a fast pack runner with its own silhouette and its own sound; not a copy of any beast in the donor

top_creatures.label: Web skitter companion
top_creatures.why: Same summon mechanism with a different body plan, so the summon family reads as varied. Silhouette and sound not read.
top_creatures.keep: one archive per beast; one summon slot per caster
top_creatures.change: a skitter with a web-line attack, designed from scratch

top_creatures.label: Slow brute companion
top_creatures.why: A heavy companion next to the fast one gives a size contrast at 375 wide. Silhouette not read.
top_creatures.change: a short-lived brute with a telegraphed slam; the slam is ours

looks.label: gilt env pass, under mode
looks.technique: reflective environment map drawn first, then the same mesh drawn with the diffuse texture on top

looks.label: gilt env pass, over mode
looks.technique: diffuse drawn first, then an environment-map-only pass; per the comment the diffuse colour modulates the reflection

looks.label: reflection sweep
looks.technique: cube reflection UV and sphere reflection UV computed in the shader, not baked

looks.label: glow mask
looks.technique: glow map read per mesh; self-light without a light source

looks.label: specular highlight
looks.technique: specular power and value read per mesh

looks.label: music transitions
looks.technique: crossfade, fade into a transitional sound, fade from it; per-event volume and pitch fades

looks.label: per-area minimap card
looks.technique: one image per area name, shown or hidden

originals.name: Gilt plate pass
originals.idea: Rare plated armour draws its reflection under the diffuse so it reads as metal (row 15 gear dressing).
originals.keep: reflection drawn under the diffuse layer
originals.change: reflection comes from a per-zone sky gradient; gilt tone is our own palette

originals.name: Glow-mask rune
originals.idea: A per-part glow mask that pulses without a light source, for rare gear or a boss weapon (row 16 colour grade, row 15).
originals.change: mask lives in the sprite atlas with our own slow pulse curve

originals.name: Caster-bound beast trio
originals.idea: One caster-owned companion slot with a remove call, and three beasts with distinct roles: pack runner, web skitter, slow brute (rows 2 and 13 specials).
originals.change: our three beasts, each with its own silhouette and sound

originals.name: Modular armour parts with material channels
originals.idea: Gear tiers shown by which of 12 of our parts are upgraded, with two shades per material (row 15 gear dressing).
originals.keep: per-part slots; two shades per material
originals.change: 12 slots of ours; palette of gilded metal, bone and oiled cloth instead of a generic metal set

originals.name: On-hit and elemental weapon affixes
originals.idea: Loot affixes as rows: on-hit spark, extra damage type, damage reduction (row 18 loot roll).
originals.change: three elements of ours; a spark arc on hit; no named spells

originals.name: Transition stinger
originals.idea: Boss intro and zone border crossfade into a short transitional sound (row 12 combat sound cues).
originals.keep: crossfade and fade-into a transitional sound
originals.change: our stinger is a short sound sting with a ducked music bed

originals.name: Per-zone minimap card
originals.idea: One card per zone, chosen by name, shown or hidden (row 14 HUD).
originals.keep: one card per zone; show and hide
originals.change: fog-of-war reveal from zone geometry; touch corner toggle
